questions.question: Machmeter readings are subject to:
choices: setting error.
position pressure error
density error.
temperature error.
questions.answerText: position pressure error
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The limits of the white scale of an airspeed indicator are :
choices: VSO for the lower limit and VFE for the upper limit
VSI for the lower limit and VFE for the upper limit
VSO for the lower limit and VLE for the upper limit
VSI for the lower limit and VLE for the upper limit
questions.answerText: VSO for the lower limit and VFE for the upper limit
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) computer receives information : 1- about the pressure altitude through the mode S transponder 2- from the radio-altimeter 3- specific to the airplane configuration 4- from the inertial units The combination regrouping all the correct statements is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The calculator combined with the stick shaker system of a modern transport airplane receives information about the: 1- angle of attack 2- engine R.P.M. 3- configuration 4- pitch and bank attitude 5- sideslip The combination regrouping all the correct statements is:
choices: 1 and 3.
1 and 5.
questions.answerText: 1 and 3.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The input signal of the amplifier of the gyromagnetic compass resetting device originates from the:
choices: directional gyro erection device.
error detector.
flux valve.
directional gyro unit.
questions.answerText: error detector.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Modern low altitude radioaltimeters emit waves in the following frequency band:
choices: VLF (Very Low Frequency).
HF (High Frequency).
UHF (Ultra High Frequency).
SHF (Super High Frequency).
questions.answerText: SHF (Super High Frequency).
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The magnetic heading can be derived from the true heading by means of a :
choices: compass swinging curve
map showing the isogonal lines
map showing the isoclinic lines
deviation correction curve
questions.answerText: map showing the isogonal lines
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: When the intruding aircraft is equipped with a serviceable mode C transponder, the TCAS II (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) generates a :
choices: "traffic advisory" and horizontal "resolution advisory".
"traffic advisory" only.
"traffic advisory", vertical and horizontal "resolution advisory".
"traffic advisory" and vertical "resolution advisory".
questions.answerText: "traffic advisory" and vertical "resolution advisory".
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: In an auto-pilot slaved powered control circuit, the system which ensures synchronisation :
choices: intervenes only when the automatic pilot has been engaged.
prevents uncommanded surface deflection when the automatic pilot is disengaged.
is inhibited when the automatic pilot is engaged.
can itself, when it fails, prevent the automatic pilot from being engaged.
questions.answerText: can itself, when it fails, prevent the automatic pilot from being engaged.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The signal supplied by a transmitter fitted with a 3- phase AC generator, connected to RPM indicator, is :
choices: an AC voltage, the frequency of which varies with the RPM; the indicator converts the signal into square pulses which are then counted
an AC voltage varying with the RPM; the indicator rectifies the signal via a diode bridge and is provided with a voltmeter
a three-phase voltage, the frequency of which varies with the RPM; the indicator is provided with a motor which drives a magnetic tachometer
a DC voltage varying with the RPM; the indicator is a plain voltmeter with a rev/min. scale
questions.answerText: a three-phase voltage, the frequency of which varies with the RPM; the indicator is provided with a motor which drives a magnetic tachometer
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: A flux valve senses the changes in orientation of the horizontal component of the earth's magnetic field. 1- the flux valve is made of a pair of soft iron bars 2- the primary coils are fed A.C. voltage (usually 487.5 Hz) 3- the information can be used by a "flux gate" compass or a directional gyro 4- the flux gate valve casing is dependent on the aircraft three inertial axis 5- the accuracy on the value of the magnetic field indication is less than 0,5% Which of the following combinations contains all of the correct statements?
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The autopilot basic modes include, among other things, the following functions : 1- pitch attitude hold 2- pressure altitude hold 3- horizontal wing hold 4- heading hold The combination regrouping all the correct statements is :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: In the Southern hemisphere, during deceleration following a landing in an Easterly direction, the magnetic compass will indicate :
choices: a heading fluctuating about 090°.
an apparent turn to the North.
an apparent turn to the South.
no apparent turn.
questions.answerText: an apparent turn to the North.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The reading of a Mach indicator is independent of :
choices: the differential pressure measurement
the outside temperature
the static pressure
the total pressure
questions.answerText: the outside temperature
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: An automatic landing is carried out when the automatic pilot :
choices: and the autothrottle ensure a correct final approach, at least up to flare-out
and the autothrottle ensure a correct final approach, at least up to flare-out while the human pilot controls the power
and the autothrottle ensure a correct final approach, at least up to ground roll
ensures a correct final approach, at least up to ground roll while the human pilot controls the power
questions.answerText: and the autothrottle ensure a correct final approach, at least up to ground roll
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: Among the following functions of an autopilot, those related to the airplane stabilization are: 1- pitch attitude holding 2- horizontal wing holding 3- displayed heading or inertial track holding 4- indicated airspeed or Mach number holding 5- yaw damping 6- VOR axis holding The combination regrouping all the correct statements is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: A leak in the pitot total pressure line of a non- pressurized aircraft to an airspeed indicator would cause it to:
choices: r-read in a climb and over-read in a descent. unde
r-read. unde
over-read.
over-read in a climb and unde r-read in a descent.
questions.answerText: r-read. unde
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: An automatic landing system which can keep on operating without deterioration of its performances following the failure of one of the autopilots is called "FAIL...:
choices: "PASSIVE"
"SAFE"
"REDUNDANT"
"OPERATIONAL"
questions.answerText: "OPERATIONAL"
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The QNH is by definition the value of the:
choices: altimeter setting so that the needles indicate zero when the aircraft is on ground at the location for which it is provided.
atmospheric pressure at the level of the ground overflown by the aircraft.
altimeter setting so that the needles of the altimeter indicate the altitude of the location for which it is given.
atmospheric pressure at the sea level of the location for which it is given.
questions.answerText: altimeter setting so that the needles of the altimeter indicate the altitude of the location for which it is given.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: At a constant calibrated airspeed (CAS), the Mach number :
choices: remains unchanged when the outside temperature increases
remains unchanged when the outside temperature decreases
increases when the altitude increases
decreases when the altitude increases
questions.answerText: increases when the altitude increases
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: On a TCAS2 (Traffic Collision Avoidance System), a corrective "resolution advisory" (RA) is a "resolution advisory":
choices: asking the pilot to modify the heading of his aircraft.
asking the pilot to modify the speed of his aircraft.
asking the pilot to modify effectively the vertical speed of his aircraft.
which does not require any action from the pilot but on the contrary asks him not to modify his current vertical speed rate.
questions.answerText: asking the pilot to modify effectively the vertical speed of his aircraft.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: When being engaged, and without selecting a particular mode, an automatic pilot enables :
choices: aeroplane piloting and guidance functions.
a constant speed on track, wings horizontal.
all aeroplane piloting and guidance functions except maintaining radio-navigation course lines.
aeroplane stabilisation with attitude hold or maintaining vertical speed and possibly automatic trim.
questions.answerText: aeroplane stabilisation with attitude hold or maintaining vertical speed and possibly automatic trim.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The use of the TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) for avoiding an aircraft in flight is now general. TCAS uses for its operation :
choices: the replies from the transponders of other aircraft
the echos from the ground air traffic control radar system
the echos of collision avoidance radar system especially installed on board
both the replies from the transponders of other aircraft and the ground-based radar echoes
questions.answerText: the replies from the transponders of other aircraft
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: When an aircraft has turned 360 degrees with a constant attitude and bank, the pilot observes the following on a classic artificial horizon :
choices: too much nose-up and bank correct
too much nose-up and bank too high
attitude and bank correct
too much nose-up and bank too low
questions.answerText: attitude and bank correct
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The basic principle used for measuring a quantity of fuel in a transport airplane equipped with "capacitor" gauges is that the:
choices: electromotive force of a capacity depends on the nature of the dielectric in which it is immersed.
capacity of a capacitor depends on the nature of the dielectric in which it is immersed.
internal resistance of a capacity depends on the nature of the dielectric in which it is immersed.
capacity of a capacitor depends on the distance between its plates.
questions.answerText: capacity of a capacitor depends on the nature of the dielectric in which it is immersed.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The yellow sector of the temperature gauge corresponds to:
choices: a forbidden operating range.
an exceptional operating range.
a normal operating range.
a frequent operating range.
questions.answerText: an exceptional operating range.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: VLE is the maximum :
choices: speed authorized in flight
flight speed with landing gear down
speed at which the landing gear can be operated with full safety
speed with flaps extended in a given position
questions.answerText: flight speed with landing gear down
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The temperature measured by the CHT (Cylinder Head temperature) probe is the :
choices: temperature within the hottest cylinder, depending on its position in the engine block.
average temperature within the whole set of cylinders.
temperature of the exhaust gases.
temperature of the carburator to be monitored when the outside air temperature is between -5°C and 10°C.
questions.answerText: temperature within the hottest cylinder, depending on its position in the engine block.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The flight data recorder must start data recording automatically:
choices: when lining up.
before the airplane is able to move by under its own power.
when taking-off.
when the landing gear is retracted.
questions.answerText: before the airplane is able to move by under its own power.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The advantages of single-phase A.C. generator tachometer are: 1- the suppression of spurious signals due to a D.C. generator commutator 2- the importance of line resistance on the information value 3- the independence of the information in relation to the airborne electrical power supply 4- the ease of transmission of the information The combination regrouping all the correct statements is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The airspeed indicator of a twin-engined aircraft comprises different sectors and color marks. The blue line corresponds to the :
choices: optimum climbing speed with one engine inoperative, or Vy
speed not to be exceeded, or VNE
minimum control speed, or VMC
maximum speed in operations, or VMO
questions.answerText: optimum climbing speed with one engine inoperative, or Vy
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The Ground Proximity Warning System (GPWS) generates the following sound signal or signals when the aircraft is sinking after a take-off or a go-around :
choices: WHOOP WHOOP PULL UP repetitive only
DON'T SINK always followed by WHOOP WHOOP PULL UP
DON'T SINK followed by WHOOP WHOOP PULL UP if the sink rate overshoots a second level
DON'T SINK repetitive only
questions.answerText: DON'T SINK repetitive only
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: Different pressure sensors are used according to the intensity of the pressure measured (low, medium or Classify the following sensors by order of increasing pressure for which they are suitable : 1- bellows type 2- Bourdon tube type 3- aneroid capsule type high)
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The response time of a vertical speed detector may be increased by adding a:
choices: bimettalic strip
return spring
second calibrated port
correction based on an accelerometer sensor.
questions.answerText: correction based on an accelerometer sensor.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: An aeroplane is in steady cruise at flight level 270. The autothrottle maintains a constant calibrated airspeed. If the total temperature decreases, the Mach number :
choices: remains constant.
increases.
decreases.
increases if the outside temperature is higher than the standard temperature, decreases if lower.
questions.answerText: remains constant.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The command bars of a flight director are generally represented on an:
choices: RMI (Radio Magnetic Indicator)
ILS (Instrument Landing System)
ADI (Attitude Director Indicator)
HSI (Horizontal Situation Indicator)
questions.answerText: ADI (Attitude Director Indicator)
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: A pilot wishes to turn right on to a southerly heading with 20° bank at a latitude of 20° North. Using a direct reading compass, in order to achieve this he must stop the turn on an approximate heading of :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: According to the JAR-OPS regulations, the Cockpit Voice Recorder of a 50 seat multi-engined aircraft, having been granted an airworthiness certificate after 1st April 1998, shall start recording :
choices: Automatically when the wheels leave the ground until the moment when the wheels touch the ground again.
From the first radio contact with Air Traffic Control until radio shutdown after the flight.
When the pilot selects the "CVR: ON" during engine start until the pilot selects the "CVR: OFF" during the engine shut down.
Automatically prior to the aircraft moving under its own power until flight completion when the aircraft is no longer able to move under its own power.
questions.answerText: Automatically prior to the aircraft moving under its own power until flight completion when the aircraft is no longer able to move under its own power.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The primary factor which makes the servo-assisted altimeter more accurate than the simple pressure altimeter is the use of:
choices: a sub-scale logarithmic function
an induction pick-off device
more effective temperature compensating leaf springs
combination of counters/pointers
questions.answerText: an induction pick-off device
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: In accordance with (ICAO) Annex 6 part I, the flight data recorder is to be located in the aircraft :
choices: as near to the landing gear as practicable
at the right or left wing tip
as far to the rear as practicable
as far forward as practicable
questions.answerText: as far to the rear as practicable
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: Today's airspeed indicators (calibrated to the Saint- Venant formula), indicate, in the absence of static (and instrumental) error :
choices: The true airspeed
The airspeed, whatever the altitude
The equivalent airspeed, in all cases
The conventional airspeed (CAS) in all cases
questions.answerText: The conventional airspeed (CAS) in all cases
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The indication of the directional gyro as an on-board instrument are valid only for a short period of time. The causes of this inaccuracy are : 1. The earth's rotation 2. The longitudinal acceleration 3. The aircraft's motion over the surface of the earth. 4. The mechanical defects of the gyro 5. The gyro's weight 6. The gimbal mount of the gyro rings The combination of correct statements is :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The static air temperature (SAT) is :
choices: a relative temperature expressed in degrees Kelvin
an absolute temperature expressed in degrees Celsius
a differential temperature expressed in degrees Kelvin
a relative temperature expressed in degrees Celsius
questions.answerText: an absolute temperature expressed in degrees Celsius
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Among the errors of a magnetic compass, are errors:
choices: of parallax, due to oscillations of the compass rose
in North seeking, due to bank angle and magnetic heading
due to cross-wind gusts particularly on westerly or easterly headings
due to Schüler type oscillations
questions.answerText: in North seeking, due to bank angle and magnetic heading
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: A failed RMI rose is locked on 090° and the ADF pointer indicates 225°. The relative bearing to the station is :
choices: Impossible to read, due to failure RMI.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The characteristics of the directional gyro (DG) used in a gyro stabilised compass system are :
choices: two degrees of freedom, whose axis aligned with the vertical to the location is maintained in this direction by an erecting system.
one degree of freedom, whose horizontal axis is maintained in the horizontal plane by an automatic erecting system.
one degree of freedom, whose vertical axis, aligned with the real vertical to the location is maintained in this direction by an automatic erecting system.
two degrees of freedom, whose horizontal axis corresponding to the reference direction is maintained in the horizontal plane by an automatic erecting system.
questions.answerText: two degrees of freedom, whose horizontal axis corresponding to the reference direction is maintained in the horizontal plane by an automatic erecting system.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: Magnetic compass swinging is carried out to reduce as much as possible :
choices: variation.
regulation.
acceleration.
deviation.
questions.answerText: deviation.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: Under normal operating conditions, when an aircraft is in a banked turn, the rate-of-turn indicator is a valuable gyroscopic flight control in strument ; when it is associated with an attitude indicator it indicates : 1. the angular velocity of the aircraft about the yaw axis 2. The bank of the aircraft 3. The direction of the aircraft turn 4. The angular velocity of the aircraft about the real vertical The combination of correct statements is :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: An "altitude warning system" must at least warn the crew : 1- when approaching the pre-selected altitude 2- when the airplane is approaching the ground too fast 3- in case of a given deviation above or below the pre- selected altitude (at least by an aural warning) 4- in case of excessive vertical speed 5- when approaching the ground with the gear retracted The combination regrouping all the correct statements is :
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The gauge indicating the quantity of fuel measured by a capacity gauging system can be graduated directly in weight units because the dielectric constant of fuel is:
choices: twice that of air and varies inversely with density.
the same as that of air and varies inversely with density.
twice that of air and varies directly with density.
the same as that of air and varies directly with density.
questions.answerText: twice that of air and varies directly with density.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: A pitot tube covered by ice which blocks the ram air inlet will affect the following instrument (s) :
choices: airspeed indicator only.
altimeter only.
vertical speed indicator only.
airspeed indicator, altimeter and vertical speed indicator.
questions.answerText: airspeed indicator only.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: During a Category II automatic approach, the height information is supplied by the :
choices: encoding altimeter.
altimeter.
radio altimeter.
GPS (Global Positioning System).
questions.answerText: radio altimeter.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: An aircraft takes-off on a runway with an alignment of 045°. The isogonic line on the area chart indicates 0°. The compass deviation is O°. On a take-off with zero wind, the northerly turning error:
choices: is such that the compass will indicate a value noticeably above 045°.
will be nul if the wings are kept level.
will be nul
is such that the compass will indicate a value noticeably below 045°.
questions.answerText: is such that the compass will indicate a value noticeably below 045°.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: With a pitot probe blocked due to ice build up, the aircraft airspeed indicator will indicate in descent a :
choices: decreasing speed.
constant speed.
increasing speed.
fluctuating speed.
questions.answerText: decreasing speed.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: A "TCAS II" (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) provides:
choices: a simple intruding airplane proximity warning.
the intruder relative position and possibly an indication of a collision avoidance manoeuvre within both the vertical and horizontal planes.
the intruder relative position and possibly an indication of a collision avoidance manoeuvre within the horizontal plane only.
the intruder relative position and possibly an indication of a collision avoidance manoeuvre within the vertical plane only.
questions.answerText: the intruder relative position and possibly an indication of a collision avoidance manoeuvre within the vertical plane only.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: A gravity erector system is used to correct the errors on :
choices: a directional gyro.
a turn indicator.
a gyromagnetic compass.
an artificial horizon.
questions.answerText: an artificial horizon.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The operating principle of Flowmeters, or "unit flow meters," the most commonly used at the present time, is to measure across their system the :
choices: pressure and temperature of the fuel
volumetric mass and di-electric resistance of the fuel
volume and viscosity of the fuel
quantity of fuel movement
questions.answerText: quantity of fuel movement
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: A synchroscope is used on aircraft to:
choices: reduce the vibration of each engine.
reduce the rpm of each engine.
achieve optimum control of on-board voltages.
set several engines to the same speed.
questions.answerText: set several engines to the same speed.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: (For this question use appendix ) The diagram representing a left turn with insufficient rudder is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: A "close traffic advisory" is displayed on the display device of the TCAS 2 (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) by :
choices: a blue or white full lozenge.
a red full square.
a blue or white empty lozenge.
an orange full circle.
questions.answerText: a blue or white empty lozenge.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: VNE is the maximum speed :
choices: with flaps extended in landing position
which must never be exceeded
not to be exceeded except in still air and with caution
at which the flight controls can be fully deflected
questions.answerText: which must never be exceeded
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: Among the following functions of an autopilot, those related to the airplane guidance are: 1- pitch attitude holding 2- horizontal wing holding 3- indicated airspeed or Mach number holding 4- altitude holding 5- VOR axis holding 6- yaw damping The combination regrouping all the correct statements is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: A landing is performed automatically when the autopilot and auto-throttle ensure good performance from the final approach :
choices: during the landing roll and sometimes until the aircraft comes to a complete stop.
until reaching 100 ft, height at which point the autopilot is automatically disconnected.
until the flare.
until reaching decision height.
questions.answerText: during the landing roll and sometimes until the aircraft comes to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: Mode "Localizer ARM" active on Flight Director means:
choices: Localizer is armed and coupling will occur when flag warning disappears
System is armed for localizer approach and coupling will occur upon capturing center line
Localizer ALARM, making localizer approach not authorized
Coupling has occurred and system provides control data to capture the centerline
questions.answerText: System is armed for localizer approach and coupling will occur upon capturing center line
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The TCAS 1 (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) provides : 1- traffic information 2- horizontal resolution (RA: Resolution Advisory) 3- vertical resolution (RA: Resolution Advisory) 4- ground proximity warning The combination regrouping all the correct statements is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: If the GPWS (Ground Proximity Warning System) activates, and alerts the pilot with an aural warning "DON'T SINK" (twice times), it is because :
choices: during take-off or missed approach manoeuvre, the aircraft has started to loose altitude.
the aircraft experiences an unexpected proximity to the terrain, with landing gear retracted.
at too low altitude, the aircraft has an excessive rate of descent.
the aircraft experiences an unexpected proximity to terrain, without landing-flap selected.
questions.answerText: during take-off or missed approach manoeuvre, the aircraft has started to loose altitude.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The inputs to the GPWS (Ground Proximity Warning System), are: 1- Air Data Computer - (Mach number and Vertical Speed) 2- Radio Altimeter 3- NAV/ILS (Glide Slope) 4- NAV/VOR 5- Flap (position) 6- Angle of Attack 7- Landing Gear (position) The combination of correct statement is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The purpose of Auto Throttle is:
choices: automatic shut down of one engine at too high temperature
to deactivate manual throttles and transfer engine control to Auto Pilot
to synchronize engines to avoid "yawing"
to maintain constant engine power or airplane speed
questions.answerText: to maintain constant engine power or airplane speed
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The principle of capacitor gauges is based on:
choices: the variation of capacity by volumetric measurement exercised on the sensor
the variation of flow and torque exercised in a supply line
the variation in capacity of a condensor with the nature of the dielectric
the current variation in a Wheastone bridge
questions.answerText: the variation in capacity of a condensor with the nature of the dielectric
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: (For this question use annex 022-11232A) After having programmed your flight director, you see that the indications of your ADI (Attitude Director indicator) are as represented in diagram N°1 of the appended annex. On this instrument, the command bars indicate that you must :
choices: increase the flight attitude and bank your airplane to the left until the command bars recentre on the symbolic aeroplane.
increase the flight attitude and bank your aeroplane to the right until the command bars recentre on the symbolic aeroplane.
decrease the flight attitude and bank your airplane to the left until the command bars recentre on the symbolic aeroplane.
decrease the flight attitude and bank your airplane to the right until the command bars recentre on the symbolic aeroplane.
questions.answerText: increase the flight attitude and bank your airplane to the left until the command bars recentre on the symbolic aeroplane.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: A gravity type erector is used in a vertical gyro device to correct errors on :
choices: an artificial horizon
a directional gyro unit
a turn indicator
a gyromagnetic indicator
questions.answerText: an artificial horizon
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The fields affecting a magnetic compass originate from: 1. magnetic masses 2. ferrous metal masses 3. non ferrous metal masses 4. electrical currents The combination of correct statements is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: A turn indicator is built around a gyroscope with:
choices: 0 degree of freedom.
1 degree of freedom.
3 degrees of freedom.
2 degrees of freedom.
questions.answerText: 2 degrees of freedom.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: The purpose of the altitude alert system is to generate a visual and aural warning to the pilot when the:
choices: airplane altitude differs from a selected altitude.
airplane altitude is equal to the decision altitude.

7.5°/hour to the left.
10.5°/hour to the right.
questions.answerText: 10.5°/hour to the right.

questions.question: The signal supplied by a transmitter fitted with a magnetic sensor, connected to an RPM indicator is :

a DC voltage varying with the RPM ; the indicator is a simple voltmeter with a rev/min. scale
an AC voltage varying with the RPM ; the indicator rectifies the signal via a diode bridge and is provided with a voltmeter
an AC voltage, the frequency of which varies with the RPM; the indicator converts the signal into square pulses which are then counted
questions.answerText: an AC voltage, the frequency of which varies with the RPM; the indicator converts the signal into square pulses which are then counted

questions.question: VFE is the maximum speed :

with the flaps extended in a given position.
with the flaps extended in landing position.
at which the flaps can be operated.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The white sector of the arc of a temperature gauge corresponds to:
choices: a special operating range.
a normal operating range.
an exceptional operating range.
a forbidden operating range.
questions.answerText: a special operating range.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The principle of capacity gauges is based on the:
choices: current variation in the Wheatstone bridge.
capacitance variation by the volume measurement carried out on the sensor.
flow rate and torque variation occurring in a supply line.
capacitance variation of a given capacitor with the type of dielectric.
questions.answerText: capacitance variation of a given capacitor with the type of dielectric.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option D as correct.

questions.question: Except for airplanes under 5,7 t airworthiness certificate of which is subsequent to 31 march 1998, a flight data recording system must be able to store the recorded data for a minimum of the last :
choices: 30 minutes.
60 minutes.
25 hours.
10 hours.
questions.answerText: 25 hours.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The purpose of the vibrating device of an altimeter is to:

inform the crew of a failure of the instrument
allow damping of the measurement in the unit
reduce the hysteresis effect
questions.answerText: reduce the effect of friction in the linkages
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

choices: offset EPSILON at the computer input.
pilot command E.
aircraft response S.
real deflection of the control surface (BETA control surface feedback).
questions.answerText: offset EPSILON at the computer input.

questions.question: The maximum directional gyro error due to the earth rotation is:

90°/hour
180°/hour
5°/hour
questions.answerText: 15°/hour
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: When an aircraft, operating in the VOR coupled mode, approaches the "cone of confusion" over a VOR station, the roll channel of the autopilot :
choices: remains always coupled to the selected VOR radial.
is temporarily disconnected.
temporarily switches over to the heading mode.
is damped by a trim input signal from the lateral trim system.
questions.answerText: temporarily switches over to the heading mode.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The altitude indicated on board an aircraft flying in an atmosphere where all the atmosphere layers below the aircraft are cold is :
choices: lower than the real altitude.
the same as the real altitude.
higher than the real altitude.
equal to the standard altitude.
questions.answerText: lower than the real altitude.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: In An Air Data Computer (ADC), aeroplane altitude is calculated from:
choices: Measurement of outside air temperature (OAT)
Measurement of elapsed time for a radio signal transmitted to the ground surface and back
Measurement of absolute barometric pressure from a static source on the fuselage
The difference between absolute and dynamic pressure at the fuselage
questions.answerText: Measurement of absolute barometric pressure from a static source on the fuselage
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The RPM indicator (or tachometer) of a piston engine can include a small red arc within the arc normally used (green arc) In the RPM range corresponding to this small red arc the :
choices: propoller generates vibration, continuous rating is forbidden
rating is the maximum possible in continuous mode
rating is the minimum usable in cruise
propeller efficency is minimum at this rating
questions.answerText: propoller generates vibration, continuous rating is forbidden
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: In the Northern hemisphere, during deceleration following a landing in a Westerly direction, the magnetic compass will indicate :
choices: an apparent turn to the South.
an apparent turn to the North.
no apparent turn.
a heading fluctuating about 270°.
questions.answerText: an apparent turn to the South.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

questions.question: The quadrantal deviation of a magnetic compass is corrected by using :

magnetized needles
soft iron pieces
hard iron pieces

questions.question: The altimeter consists of one or several aneroid capsules located in a sealed casing. The pressures in the aneroid capsule (i) and casing (ii) are respectively :

questions.question: The "heading hold" mode is selected on the flight director (FD) with a course to steer of 180°. Your aircraft holds a heading of 160°. The vertical bar of the FD:

cannot be centered
is centered if the aircraft is on optimum path to join heading 180°
is centered if the aircraft has a starboard drift of 20°
questions.answerText: is centered if the aircraft is on optimum path to join heading 180°
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: A millivoltmeter measuring the electromotive force between the "hot junction" and the "cold junction" of a thermocouple can be directly graduated in temperature values provided that the temperature of the:

hot junction is maintained constant.

hot junction is maintained at 15 °C.

questions.question: The sensors used to measure the exhaust gas temperature on an aircraft equipped with turbojets are:

based on metallic conductors whose resistance increases linearly with temperature.
capacitors whose capacity varies proportionnally with temperature.
thermocouples.

questions.question: The angle of attack transmitters placed laterally on the forward part of the fuselage supply an electrical signal indicating: 1- the angular position of a wind vane 2- a differential pressure in a probe, depending on the variation of the angle of attack 3- a differential pressure in a probe, depending on the variation of the speed The combination regrouping all the correct statements is:
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: The Engine Pressure Ratio (EPR) is computed by :

multiplying compressor inlet pressure by turbine discharge pressure.
multiplying compressor discharge pressure by turbine inlet pressure.
dividing turbine discharge pressure by compressor inlet pressure.

questions.question: The measurement of the turbine temperature or of the EGT (Exhaust Gas Temperature) is carried out at the :

combustion chamber outlet.
combustion chamber intake.
high pressure chamber intake.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option A as correct.

autopilot maintains a vertical speed depending on the radio altimeter height.
glideslope mode is disconnected and the airplane continues its descent until landing.
autopilot maintains an angle of attack depending on the radio altimeter height.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: When compared with the volumetric fuel flowmeter, the mass fuel flowmeter takes into account the fuel :

dielectrical constant.
density.
temperature.

questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option C as correct.

questions.question: The automatic trim is a component of the autopilot pitch channel. Its function is to:
choices: automatically disengage the autopilot in the case of an excessive pitch up.
transfer a stabilized aeroplane to the pilot during autopilot disengagement.
reset the attitude, after engaging (the autopilot).
set the attitude to an instantaneous value before engaging the autopilot.
questions.answerText: transfer a stabilized aeroplane to the pilot during autopilot disengagement.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.

questions.question: A paddle-wheel placed in a the fuel circuit of a gas turbine engine initially measures:

mass flow by a tally of the impulses
volumetric flow by measure of a voltage proportional to the rotational speed
mass flow by measure of a voltage proportional to the rotational speed
questions.answerText: volumetric flow by a tally of the impulses

questions.question: At a low bank angle, the measurement of rate-o f-turn actually consists in measuring the :
choices: pitch rate of the aircraft
roll rate of the aircraft

yaw rate of the aircraft

"OPERATIONAL"
"SAFE"

questions.question: Concerning the TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) :
choices: No protection is available against aircraft not equipped with a serviceable SSR transponder
In one of the system modes, the warning : "TOO LOW TERRAIN" is generated
In one of the system modes, the warning : "PULL UP" is generated
Resolution Advisory (RA) must not be followed without obtaining clearance from ATC
questions.answerText: No protection is available against aircraft not equipped with a serviceable SSR transponder

place the antennas on the bottom of the aeroplane.
change the display scale in short final, in order to have a precise readout.
questions.answerText: account for signal processing time in the unit and apply a correction factor to the reading.
questions.explanation: The answer sheet in the source PDF marks option B as correct.
